create.versionNote: No version exists until the first Publish (→ v1).

nameDuplicate: A strategy with this name already exists.

empty.noStrategies: No strategies. Create one to begin.
empty.noGroups: No groups yet. Add a group, then add rules to it.
empty.noTrades: No trades are associated with this strategy yet.

archivedBanner: Archived — read-only. Versions, history and trade association are retained.

publishConfirm.question: Publish these changes as <0>v{{version}}</0>? It becomes the current version and is frozen.
publishConfirm.questionWithPrevious: Publish these changes as <0>v{{version}}</0>? It becomes the current version and is frozen; <0>v{{previous}}</0> stays in Version History unchanged.

deleteConfirm: Delete this unpublished strategy? It has no versions or trades.

draft.basedOn: Editing unpublished changes based on <0>v{{version}}</0>. Published <0>v{{version}}</0> remains unchanged.
draft.firstDraft: Editing the first Draft — no version exists until it is published.
draft.unpublishedNote: Draft — not yet published. No version exists until the first Publish (→ v1).

publishedBanner: Published <0>v{{version}}</0> — frozen, read-only. Rule changes are made in a Draft (Rules → Edit Rules).
readOnlyBanner: Published <0>v{{version}}</0> · read-only. Published versions are frozen — changes are made in a Draft.

overview.detailsNote: Name and description are saved directly. They do not create a Draft or a new version, and never change published versions.
overview.pooledNote: Pooled over rule results. An observation, not evidence that any rule causes any outcome.
overview.pnlDisclaimer: Shown for context only. P&L is not an input to compliance and does not indicate process quality.
